title: Charming log cabin 20 min from downtown Nashville!
description:
Welcome to our charming log cabin Horseshoe Ridge!  It was lovingly created using unique elements - Timbers and lumber from a turn-of-the -century dairy barn, and lumber milled from trees where the cabin now stands!  Dramatic wall of windows facing into the forest valley below, and soaring ceilings of Colorado blue spruce. Horseshoe Ridge is situated on 10 wooded acres, and owner lives on property. There are three bedrooms and two full baths, both of which feature luxurious towel warmers.

The space
Our beautiful log cabin is situated on 10 wooded acres within a short drive to Interstate 40.  It is serene and quiet.
